program.name: Balanced Volume
program.subject: Balanced week
program.blurb: Three balanced days: every one lifts, raises the heart rate, and finishes on a flow or core.
program.about: Every kind of training, every day, across a three-day rotation. Straight-set strength opens each session; then a Tabata, a few rounds of shadowboxing or an EMOM; then a flow or a core circuit. Nothing gets skipped for long. Level II moves you one weight up and Level III adds reps.
program.split: Lift, Tabata & flow / lift, bouts & core / lift, EMOM & flow
